name: @intellectual-frontiers/anyfs-cli
description: The `anyfs` program: POSIX-style access to any AnyFS store (ls, cat, cp, rm, find, grep, diff) and the bridge verbs (sync, bisync, mirror, check, merge, sync-medium), `serve` (WebDAV) and the keys of signed merges (keygen, roster) from the command line, a tool server and a REST description, with every operation saying how it was carried out and every destruction a plan first.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
